nodes.name: USB Power Input
responsibilities: Accept USB bus power from the connected laptop
Supply regulated operating voltage to all on-device subsystems

nodes.name: 3-Axis Acceleration Sensing (MPU6050 via I2C)
responsibilities: Measure linear acceleration along the X, Y, and Z axes using the MPU6050 IMU (user-stated constraint)
Expose raw acceleration register data over the I2C bus (user-stated constraint)
Restrict active measurement to acceleration channels only — gyroscope and other MPU6050 outputs are not read (user-stated constraint)

nodes.name: I2C Acquisition Interface
responsibilities: Initiate and manage I2C transactions to the MPU6050 at its configured device address
Issue register-read commands to retrieve raw acceleration data words for all three axes
Handle I2C timing, acknowledgement, and bus arbitration at the functional level

nodes.name: Acceleration Data Processing & Formatting
responsibilities: Receive raw 16-bit acceleration register values from the I2C acquisition interface
Convert raw values to meaningful acceleration units (e.g., applying sensitivity scale factor)
Format X, Y, and Z acceleration values into a human-readable serial output string

nodes.name: Serial Transmission Output
responsibilities: Transmit formatted X/Y/Z acceleration strings over the USB-serial interface to the connected laptop
Maintain continuous streaming of acceleration data at the configured output rate

nodes.name: Laptop Serial Monitor (External)
responsibilities: Receive and display the streamed serial acceleration data for the user to observe in real time

edges.description: Regulated supply voltage delivered to the MPU6050 IMU sensing subsystem
Regulated supply voltage delivered to the I2C acquisition interface logic
Regulated supply voltage delivered to the processing and formatting subsystem

I2C register-read commands and device address selection sent to the MPU6050
Raw 16-bit acceleration register values for X, Y, and Z axes returned over I2C

Formatted human-readable acceleration string (X/Y/Z values) passed to the serial transmission subsystem
Continuous stream of formatted X/Y/Z acceleration text transmitted over USB-serial to the laptop monitor
USB bus power sourced from the laptop to the device power input subsystem
